# Buildora Projects
> Premium construction, development, and interior execution in Lahore, Pakistan.

## About
Buildora Projects is a Lahore-based construction, development, and interior execution company. We deliver premium quality across every phase of building: architecture, construction, interiors, project management, smart automation, procurement, and facility management.

## Services
- Architecture & Design
- Construction & Development
- Interior Fit Out Solutions
- Project Management
- Smart Home & Building Automation
- Facility & Property Management
- Procurement & Supply Chain

## Notable Projects
D-Heights, Defence Raya Club, Jalal Sons, LalQila Restaurant, Papa Johns, Cheezious, Gourmet Foods, Hardee's, Dubai Islamic Bank, Samba Bank, HBL Bank, Celebrity Residence, Celebrity Project
